subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enthusiastic
solution:
The correct answer is: Apathetic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enthusiastic"** means having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **enthusiastic **about the new project and couldn't wait to get started.
 
 
 
• **"Apathetic"** refers to showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the exciting news, he remained **apathetic **and showed no reaction.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Enthusiastic'** is **'Apathetic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fanatic** (कट्टरपंथी): A person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a fitness **fanatic **who spends hours at the gym every day.
 
 
 
• **Desperate** (निराश): Feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with.
 
 
• **Example: **She made a **desperate **attempt to save her job.
 
 
 
• **Courageous** (साहसी): Not deterred by danger or pain; brave.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters made a **courageous **effort to save the people trapped in the building.
